column2: a=${1%%:*}; t=${1#*:}; case $a in main|branch) ;; *) exit 2 ;; esac; f=${JG_STATE_OVERRIDE:-${JG_HOME:?}/state}/.wake-status-$a.json; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo idle; exit; }; jq -r --arg t "$t" 'if ((.[$t].seqs // []) | length) == 0 then "idle" elif any(.[$t].events[]; (.kind | startswith("OUTCOME")) and .disposition == null) then "presented" else "handled" end' "$f"
